description: This PHP file defines a validation rule class 'TimezoneName' used to validate timezone strings within the OrangeHRM project. It extends an abstract validation rule and provides methods to validate timezone inputs by checking if they are valid timezone identifiers using PHP's DateTimeZone class.

classes.name: TimezoneName
classes.description: A validation rule class to verify if a given string is a valid timezone identifier.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input is a string and a valid timezone.

methods.name: isValidTimezone
methods.description: Checks if the provided string is a valid timezone by attempting to create a DateTimeZone object; catches exceptions to determine invalid timezones.
